desc:
Start in a garage with one old computer and build the biggest game studio in history! 🎮

💡 DESIGN your own games: pick the name, genre, platforms, features, box art and price
👥 HIRE your Roblox friends as developers, testers and researchers
🎆 LAUNCH every game in a live show (countdown, trailer, fireworks or a spooky premiere), then hear the critics' verdict
💰 SELL millions of copies and beat the rival studios' blockbusters
🛋️ DECORATE your office with dozens of desks, arcade machines, plants and trophies
🏢 MOVE UP from a garage to an indie studio, an office, headquarters and a campus above the clouds...
🌕 ...then take your whole studio to the MOON!
🔬 RESEARCH 70 years of tech, from 1980s pixels to the future
🎃 SEASONAL EVENTS with special decorations for Halloween, winter and summer
⭐ PRESTIGE to start over stronger with permanent bonuses

Will your next game be a MASTERPIECE? 🏆
